script_text: Gemini, the cosmos is forcing your natural Air element into very serious action this coming week. Early Monday, Venus joins your Sun in the 5th House, sparking a magnetic, fated romance demanding your complete, total attention. But Jupiter in your 1st House amplifies confidence, making every single word you speak land heavily on everyone listening. Mid-week, your ruler Mercury trines Saturn in your 10th House, sealing a major salary negotiation or career promotion. Late week, Mars squares Pluto creating friction with partners, so pause completely before arguing on Saturday night. Wednesday is your absolute power day because Venus aligns with your Sun in your 5th House. Friday is your very worst day because Mars squares Pluto in your 3rd House of communication issues. Wait patiently for the Mercury trine to fully close deals before rushing into any binding contracts. Follow for daily updates tomorrow morning.
